name: Laika
description: Laika is a Scala library and toolkit for transforming lightweight markup into HTML, EPUB and PDF; a site is a small Scala program built on its transformer API.
runtime: Scala 3 fat jar on a JRE (scala-cli, Temurin 21)
notes: Laika is used as a library through laika-io; the Helium theme is not used.
